_provenance: SP-1 R0 Block E-b — E5 Nirmal J(t) perf gate. MEASURED 2026-07-18 on gpubox (WSL2, 2x NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 48GB sm_89, driver 13.2, Warp 1.14 / CUDA Toolkit 12.9, .venv/bin/python). Driver: benchmarks/xdd/e5_perf_nirmal.py (level 8 = 257x257 = 66049 nodes = 330245 DOFs, DOF-matched proxy for the 513x129=66177-node Nirmal mesh; marchable regime lam2=1e-1, Eg_hat=4, symmetric mu, 10 GHz rect-sin, dt=5ps, cuda:0). GPU run REQUIRES LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib (WSL libcuda shadowing). Perf numbers are LEDGER-LOCKED, not CI-reasserted (test asserts the file parses + the recorded speedup matches the recorded arithmetic).

measured._size_note: 513x129 = 66177 nodes; no anisotropic octree in-tree (build_uniform is square 2^level). Measured at level 8 = 257x257 = 66049 nodes = 0.19% DOF match. Per-step cost is DOF/sparsity-governed (nondim h_hat in [0,1]), so the square proxy is faithful for perf.
measured.regime: marchable (lam2=1e-1, Eg_hat=4, symmetric mu=0.5). Physical PM6 config hits the documented CPU-mesh drive wall (Eg_hat~42.5, Debye<<h) -> Newton bails at iter 1 (unrepresentative). Marchable runs full Newton; LU size/sparsity (the dominant cost) is IDENTICAL to physical.
measured._warmup_note: First step incl. Warp JIT compile + 4 Newton iters + host LU; one-time, excluded from s/step.
measured._steps_note: 1 ns window at 5 ps/step = 200 steps + 1 (10 GHz -> 10 optical cycles, 20 steps/cycle).
measured.solver: host scipy splu (nonsymmetric sparse LU); Warp assembles element matrices on cuda:0 but the global Jacobian CSR is built on HOST and factorized on HOST. cuDSS NOT wired (no cudss python binding on box). Closures host numpy.
measured.cpu_midrun: one core pinned at 100% (host splu + closures)
measured._bottleneck: GPU IDLE (0% util) during the 330k-DOF step; per-step cost ~ (Newton iters) x ~96s host-LU-factor+solve. The GPU is used only for element assembly, negligible at this size.

gate._baseline_note: Nirmal paper CPU baseline: 10-30 h on 36 CPU cores for one J(t) trace.
gate._end_to_end_note: PROJECTION (labeled, honest): s_per_step_median x steps_for_window. Full 1 ns trace NOT run to completion (~2 h at this variance); run stopped after 3 timed steps + warm-up, sufficient to lock the gate verdict (the s/step is invariant to the trace length; the gate misses by >18x). Uses the MEDIAN (optimistic 1-iter-dominated) projection -> the strongest honest claim (even best-case misses).
gate.verdict: MISS. Off by ~18x (vs 30h baseline) to ~55x (vs 10h). The miss is entirely attributable to the HOST scipy splu linear solve (GPU util 0% during the solve); NOT a GPU-compute limit. This is the honest finding + the exact input to the deferred A100/cuDSS speedup brainstorm.
gate.brainstorm_input: To reach >=100x at 330k DOF: wire cuDSS (GPU sparse direct LU, natural for the 2-D nonsymmetric Jacobian) into XDDSystem.linsolve, keep the CSR device-resident, reuse the symbolic factorization across the fixed-sparsity Newton iterations, and move the A3 closures onto the GPU to kill host round-trips. A _try_cudss hook already exists in the driver (returns None today -> host splu).
